title: Stored x-only leaf birthday search on secp256k1 at 124.674413534089474: truncated-fraction leaf kernels on the grouped hash-chain early abort over 114 groups with E-priced key paths, 256-record blocks, 46-bit d4

claims.statement: For uniform production secp256k1 Q=[x]P, the classical cold grouped stored-leaf birthday search of proof.md recovers x with probability at least 0.390000001 over the challenge and fresh algorithm coins, the Chen-Stein method on cross-node leaf pairs bounds P(no collision), and drops, caps, wrong class indices, label errors, the enumerated carry sites of section 3.4 and the fixup meter's cap is a charged failure row (section 6, in success.md). Its expected total work is at most 2^124.674413534089474 target-group-operation equivalents (1000 AArch64 instructions per unit; certificate.py gives at most 245.6947 per leaf), E-averaged over 114 X-groups stopping at the first resolving group with prefix non-stopping bounds; same-key records join order-free by hash chains (each group call reads its slots from per-slot read cursors to E2 and advances the cursors, so every record links exactly once to its most recent same-K2-same-d4 predecessor in a cumulative table over 2^57 heads zeroed by 2048-STP passes and linked by a packed next-array with one 16-byte entry (next address, K2) per R2 slot position (every receive pattern up to the slot caps covered by construction); walks are uncapped and run to the first full match or the chain end, so there is no overflow event; hchg costs 7 per record and 5 per chain visit plus one B after an even walk; main-pair walks and the j = 1, 2 key paths are charged by history-conditional domination times PHI[g] (KB(129) pair counting for the walks, 2/3 + 2 d_wj + 1/(r - 1) per leaf for the key paths) with same-X pairs carved out globally and defective-batch work allowed globally at unconditional d_batch); worst-case work on every run is at most 2^188.505443 instructions (HOME_MAX visits per record), disclosed. Each pair of generator points X, Y gives six leaves, the x-coordinates of phi^t(X) +- Y for t = 0, 1, 2, from one batched inverse of y_Y^2 - y_X^2, held as their discrete Fourier transform: with a = x_X, b = x_Y, E = b^4 + 2a^3 b, F = a^4 + 2ab^3, G = 3a^2 b^2 and w = 1/(y_Y +- y_X)^2, the leaves are (Ew - b) + beta^t (Fw - a) + beta^(2t) Gw, and only the six components Ew, Fw, Gw are computed, each as two 128-bit truncated fraction products T(c w), T(beta c w) on tabled rows (bwd 1285.5 instructions per pair, keys 140.5; sections 3.1, 3.3). A class's label is the top 100 bits of v*/p and (beta v* mod p)/p, v* = min(x, beta x, beta^2 x); each leaf's fractions are sums of its components' fractions with stored correction words, within [-132, 194], [-132, 194] and [-389, 264] at 128 bits, and a leaf in the window set W or the label-error set D' (rates below 2^-58.47 and 2^-16.65 per leaf) is a charged missed collision (section 3.3); a lattice count bounds a box of label values at 1 + 2^-17 times its share. Records go in blocks of k = 256 (2^14 stride, TBZ slot test, flush 8, dlvk 1026) over two hops (emit 7, h2s 7.25) with hash-chain grouping at a 46-bit d4 (sections 2.1, 4); every delivery is charged as executed route.s code and links keep no state. Peak memory at most 2^135.9989 bytes; preprocessing at most 2^118.0361 units, included; no advice; certificate.py checks the declared figures. Credits are in section 9 and the declared dependencies; no prior acceptance or score is a premise. This is an analytic bound, not a practical break.

experiments.purpose: Run the leaf kernels on production points against exact arithmetic (every stored fraction against a bit-exact model of bwd and its error bound, the Fourier identity, records against a bit-exact model of keys, indices and labels outside W and D') and the class-rule and class-label tests; the emit, both hops (each message delivered by executing dlv or dlvk) and the grouping on a 4 x 4 machine (machine.py); the grouped next-array hash-chain early-abort run with stop, full and full-list cases on the true cumulative layout with read cursors (grouped_paths); the sites and fixups of section 3.4 (sites.py); every kernel count against certificate.py, which it runs. Budget-limited parts run stated minimums. Not a production-scale attack.
